subject: Delivery address confusion
text:
Hi,

I’m trying to get the finished prototype to the client before the morning handoff, but the note I saw this morning is still confusing me about where the driver should actually go. It only says "leave it with the front desk," and that cannot mean the building entrance because the courier company would never find it there without a suite number. I already asked the client once, and they replied that "the usual contact will take it," which does not give me an address, a name, a delivery window, or a phone number. If I send it blind, I could easily be charged for a failed attempt, and my own time is not the only thing at risk; we may also lose the small rush fee that was promised if the order is late. Can you check the last two client messages and tell me, in one line, the exact pickup point, the person to ask for, and the latest acceptable arrival time? If that is unclear, maybe we should arrange a local runner instead of using the shared courier slot, even if it costs extra. I don’t want to keep the item in storage overnight just because nobody wrote down the correct instructions. If you have any screenshot or old order form showing what worked before, send it now, please, and I will place the request immediately after reading it. I will keep checking for a reply for the next twenty minutes, and if nothing arrives, I will assume we are paying for same-day transport and move ahead with that option, though I would prefer not to create another billing question for finance.
